mapper.select: /* AppMypage01Mapper.selectMyProfile */ SELECT A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , C.SITE_NM AS siteNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', A.SITE_CD, A.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm , A.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNo , A.MBL_NO_LAST4 AS mblNoLast4 , A.EMAIL_ENC AS email , A.EMAIL_DOMAIN AS emailDomain , A.BIRTH_DT_ENC AS birthDate , A.GENDER AS genderCode , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.GENDER, 'SYS004') AS genderNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginDtime , A.DEFAULT_SCH_CD AS defaultSchCd , M.SCH_NO AS defaultSchNo , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS defaultSchStrTime , M.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS defaultSchEndTime FROM TB_USER A LEFT JOIN TB_SITE C ON A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT M ON A.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = M.SITE_CD AND A.DEFAULT_SCH_CD = M.SCH_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.update: /* AppMypage01Mapper.expireOldMobileChangeSmsAuth */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET EXPIRED_AT = NOW() WHERE MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRED_AT > NOW()

/* AppMypage01Mapper.increaseMobileChangeSmsFailCnt */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET FAIL_CNT = FAIL_CNT + 1 , FAIL_LOCKED_AT = CASE WHEN FAIL_LOCKED_AT IS NULL AND FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{verifyFailLimit} THEN NOW() ELSE FAIL_LOCKED_AT END WHERE MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SMS_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: /* AppMypage01Mapper.countUnverifiedByMblHmac */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE WHERE MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AND EXPIRED_AT >= NOW() AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N'

/* AppMypage01Mapper.selectRecentVerifiedSmsId */ SELECT SMS_ID FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE WHERE MBL_NO_HMAC = #{mblNoHmac} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND UPDATE_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY UPDATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: /* AppMypage01Mapper.consumeSmsAuth */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET VERIFIED_YN = 'C' , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE SMS_ID = #{smsId} AND PURPOSE_CD = 'MOBILE_CHANGE' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* AppMypage01Mapper.selectPresetStepsByUser */ SELECT D.PRESET_ID AS presetId , D.STEP_NO AS stepNo , D.APPROVER_USER_CD AS approverUserCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.USER_ID AS userId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'BAIM_VAL', U.RANK_CD, 'COM007') AS rankNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', U.SITE_CD, U.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm FROM TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET P INNER JOIN TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET_D D ON D.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND D.PRESET_ID = P.PRESET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = D.APPROVER_USER_CD WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.PRESET_ID ASC, D.STEP_NO ASC

/* AppMypage01Mapper.selectPresetStepsById */ SELECT D.PRESET_ID AS presetId , D.STEP_NO AS stepNo , D.APPROVER_USER_CD AS approverUserCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.USER_ID AS userId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'BAIM_VAL', U.RANK_CD, 'COM007') AS rankNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', U.SITE_CD, U.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm FROM TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET P INNER JOIN TB_APRV_LINE_PRESET_D D ON D.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND D.PRESET_ID = P.PRESET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = D.APPROVER_USER_CD WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND P.PRESET_ID = #{presetId} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.STEP_NO ASC

/* AppMypage01Mapper.selectUserRankSortIdx */ SELECT D.SORT_IDX FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D D ON D.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND D.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM007' AND D.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = U.RANK_CD AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} LIMIT 1
/* AppMypage01Mapper.selectNextDefaultSchReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL

mapper.insert: /* AppMypage01Mapper.insertDefaultSchChangeReq */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_ATTD_REQ ( REQ_ID , CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , USER_CD , REQ_TYPE , TARGET_ID , REQ_STATUS , REQ_REASON , WORK_YMD , NODE_CD , WORK_SEQ , START_DATE , START_TIME , END_DATE , END_TIME , SCH_CD , DEL_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{reqId} , #{cmpnyCd} , #{siteCd} , #{userCd} , '14' , NULL , '01' , #{reqReason} , NULL , #{nodeCd} , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , #{schCd} , 'N' , #{insertNo} , NOW() )
